ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Descriptionlists.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control descriptionlists.

Type.helper: Choose the type from the available options.

ListItemText.helper: Enter the formatted content for list item text. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

SecondLevelListItemText.helper: Enter the formatted content for second level list item text. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

SecondLevelListItemIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

SecondLevelListItems.helper: Add and arrange the items used for second level list items. Remove any item you do not need.

Items.helper: Add and arrange the items used for items. Remove any item you do not need.

Title.helper: Enter the title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ListItemText.helper: Enter the formatted content for list item text. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

ItemsDescription.helper: Add and arrange the items used for items description. Remove any item you do not need.
